content: KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong ie I en patohla oh pwainda ehu sah me wiawihkihda pwehl. E pil mahsanihong ie I en kahrehda ekei aramas mah oh ekei samworo mah,
oh se en keidla ni ewen kehl me andaneki Ewen Kelen Sah Ohla oh kolahng Wahun Innom. I ahpw pahn kalohki wasao mahseno me e pahn ketikihong ie.

KAUN-O mahsanihong ie I en patohwanda mepwukat: “Kumwail nanmwarki kan en Suda oh mehn Serusalem kan, kumwail karonge dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Koht en Israel, pahn mahsanih. I pahn ketikidohng wasaht kalokolok ehu, kalokolok ehu me irail kan me pahn rong duwe pahn salohkihda kowahlap.

I pahn wia met pwehki aramas akan ar keseielahr oh kasaminehkilahr wasa kiset ar meirong ong koht teikan—soangen koht kei me pein irail oh samarail ko, oh nanmwarki kan en Suda, sohte mwahn dehdehki. Re ahpw kadirehkihla wasa kiset ntahn aramas soh dipe,
oh kauwadahng Paal pei sarawi kei pwe re en meirongkihong nair seri kan pohn kisiniei. I sohte koasoanediong irail en wia met; I pil soh mwahn kupwukupwure irair wet.
Eri, ahnsou ehu pahn kohdo me wasa kiset solahr pahn adaneki Doped, de Wahun Innom. Ahpw e pahn adanekihla Wahun Kamakamala.

Wasa kiset iei wasa me I pahn kasohrehla en mehn Suda oh Serusalem arail koasoandi koaros. I pahn mweidohng pwe ar imwintihti kan en kaloweiraildi nan mahwen oh kemeirailla. I pahn kamwengehki kahlaparail kan menpihr en pahnlahng kan oh mahn lawalo kan.
I pahn kihong soangen kalokolok laud nan kahnimw wet pwe aramas koaros me pahn keid limwah re en kilang oh pwuriamweikihla uwen ohla me wiawihong irail.

Imwintihti kan pahn kapilpene kahnimw wet oh song en kemehla towe kan. Mwekid wet pahn uk mehlel me kahrehda aramas akan me mi nan kahnimwo pahn kangala ekei towe kan, oh pil kangala pein neirail seri kan.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong ie I en kauwehla saho mwohn mesen irail ko me iang ie kohla,

oh I en patohwanohng irail dahme KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahsanih: “I pahn kauwehla aramas pwutak oh kahnimw wet nin duwen omw kauwehla sahen pwehl, me sohte kak pwurehng wiawihda. Aramas akan pahn sarepedi ar mehla kan nan Doped, pwehki eh pahn sohla wasahn seridi.
Ih duwen met me I pahn wiahiong kahnimw wet oh towe kan pwe en duwehte Doped.

Imwen Serusalem kan, tehnpas en nanmwarki kan en Suda, oh pil ihmw koaros me towe kan kin isik warpwohmwahu pohn pwelenge ong usu kan ni mwomwen meirong, oh wudekihdi wain ar meirong ong koht teikan, re pahn saminla duwehla Doped.”
Ngehi eri pwurasang Doped, wasa me KAUN-O ketin poaroneielahng pwe I en kalohki sapwellime mahsen. I ahpw patohla oh uh nan kelen Tehnpas Sarawio oh patohwanohng aramas koaros

dahme KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Koht en Israel, mahsanih: “I pahn kihong kahnimw wet, oh kahnimw koaros me mi limwah, soangen kalokolok koaros me I koasoanedier, pwehki amwail keptakai oh sohte men rong ei mahsen.”
